text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Negotiators from the government, trade unions and employers' associations agreed on Wednesday that Mozambique's minimum wage shhould be increased by 15 percent, taking it to the equivalent of about $27 per month.
- A police report says the crime rate in Mozambique in February this year was 26.1 percent lower than in the same month last year.
